final: {"number": 99, "label": "bug", "route": "repro-check", "related": [245], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/stubbing/defaultanswers/ReturnsDeepStubs.java"], "reply": "Thanks for the report. The snippet, the Mockito versions (works on 1.9.5, fails on 1.10.5) and the exception message are all included, so this is reproducible as written. The deep stub mocks are built in ReturnsDeepStubs (org.mockito.internal.stubbing.defaultanswers). Its propagateSerializationSettings method copies the parent mock's serializable mode onto each child mock created for RETURNS_DEEP_STUBS, which is where the serializable check on NotSerializableReturnValue comes from. That is the code path to look at."}
